events.title: Employee is killed when crushed between UTV dump bed and fra…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Durgin And Crowell Lumber Company, Inc. New London, NH. At 3:00 a.m. on September 27, 2024, Employee #1 started a UTV and placed their body between the elevated dump bed and the UTV frame. The dump bed came down, pinning the employee between the dump bed and the frame. The employee sustained crushing injuries and asphyxiation. Emergency responders were called to the scene, but despite efforts to rescue and treat the employee, he died from the injuries.

events.title: Employee is killed in barrel explosion
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hmi Acquisition, Llc. Weare, NH. At 1:53 p.m. on September 18, 2024, Employee #1 was working with a barrel containing an unknown substance when the barrel exploded. The explosion caused blunt force trauma to the employee's face and head. The steel barrel was the source of the impact. The employee was fatally injured by the blast.

events.title: Employee dies of asphyxiation when crushed by rolling truck…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Sunday Paving & Sealing, Inc. Middleton, NH. At 2:00 p.m. on July 19, 2024, an employee working for a construction contractor was working on a truck. The employee was working underneath the vehicle when it back over on him. The employee died from asphyxiation when his chest was crushed.

events.title: Employee fatality is due to fall from indoor climbing wall
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Vertical Dreams, Inc. Manchester, NH. At 1:30 p.m. on May 21, 2024, Employee #1 was setting a new route on an indoor climbing wall, which involved installing new holds. While climbing near the top of the wall, the knot securing the end of the climbing rope to a railing failed,causing Employee #1 to fall approximately 40 feet to the floor below. The employee sustained fatal blunt force trauma upon impact with the floor. The employee was killed.

events.title: Company owner is killed after falling from roof while instal…
events.description: 1 worker death. Brookline, NH. At approximately 11:00 a.m. on April 30, 2024, the owner of a company was installing a skylight on the roof of a building when he fell to the ground. The fall resulted in severe head trauma, and the owner died from his injuries at thescene. Emergency services responded, but the individual was pronounced dead due to the extent of the injuries sustained from the fall.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by falling tree
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Ace'S Land Worx, Llc. Plaistow, NH. At 11:30 a.m. on April 27, 2024, an employee was trying to fell the top half of a large dead tree, which was entangled with vines. The tree fell on the employee while he was in the basket of a lift. The employee was killed due to blunt force injuries to the head.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall off pickup truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Amerigas Propane, Inc. Campton, NH. At 12:15 p.m. on September 8, 2023, Employee #1 was on the lift gate of a Ford F350 pickup truck. Employee #1 fell to the ground. Employee #1 suffered head trauma, lacerations, and broken teeth. Employee #1 was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed due to electrocution
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Leo'S Tree Services & Landscaping Inc. Nashua, NH. At 12:00 p.m. on May 15, 2023, an employee was removing tree limbs from approximately 25-30 feet. The employee's buck strap struck a high voltage powerline. The employee was killed due to electrocution.

events.title: Employee is killed from head injury in fall from shelving
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Ups Supply Chain Solutions, Inc. Londonderry, NH. At 8:30 a.m. on March 31, 2023, an employee working as a shipping clerk for a package delivery service was performing order counts for the warehouse using a high lift order picker. The employee unhooked his harness from the lift and climbed onto the top of a shelving unit. The employee fell from the top of the shelving approximately 30 feet to the floor below. The employee died from a severe head injury due to impact with the concrete floor.

events.title: Employee dies after being crushed by falling tree
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: A.R.L. Tree Services Construction & Landscaping, Inc. Nashua, NH. At 8:40 a.m. on March 28, 2023, an employee working for tree service was cutting a 12-foot tree butt at the base near the ground. As the employee cut his way through the tree it began to fall to the right where the employee was kneeling the ground. The employee was unable to move out of the way in time and was crushed by the tree. The employee sustained severe internal injuries and later died.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by falling lumber load
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Alton Building Materials, Inc. Gilford, NH. At 9:00 a.m. on February 28, 2023, an employee who worked as a truck driver for freight transportation company was rolling up straps on his flatbed truck. A coworker operating a forklift began unloading the truck and bumped a skid of lumber. The skid fell off the truck and onto the employee. The employee was crushed over his entire body and died.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by falling lumber load

events.title: Employee is killed when pinned by tipped forklift mast
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Mclane Northeast Inc. Contoocook, NH. The bolts holding the mast to the power unit of the forklift broke, resulting in the mast tipping back and landing on Employee #1. Employee #1 was pinned between the mast and power unit. As a result of crushing injuries, Employee #1 was pronounced dead at the scene.

events.title: Employee dies after hits head on pavement in fall off dock
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Fresh Picks Caf?, Llc. New Ipswich, NH. On September 26, 2022, an employee was attempting to lift a box at a dock area when she bent over and fell off the dock. The employee fell forward head first onto the pavement below striking her head. She was killed. She may have had an underlying medical condition that contributed to the fall.

events.title: Employee Is Killed By Anaphylactic Shock After Multiple Bee…

events.title: Employee is killed in trip and fall off roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Unifirst Corporation. Lebanon, NH. They were near the back of the building, and the maintenance supervisor was holding one end of the tape, while Employee #1 begin walking towards the end of the building backwards, and it appears that he tripped over a roof vent pipe causing him to fall off the building. The employee was killed…

events.title: Employee is killed when runover by tree harvester

events.title: Employee is killed in fall off ladder
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: All-Bright Systems Llc. Windham, NH. While attempting to place the box on top of the shelf, the ladder suddenly twisted under the employee. Employee #1 fell to the floor and died from head injuries.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Franklin, NH. At 5:00 p.m. on January 14, 2022, an employee who had worked at a bank answeringphones died from COVID-19. The employee reported feeling ill and was hospitalized before succumbing to her illness. The date, time and other details leading up to exposure are not indicated in the narrative. Information regardingengineering, administrative and personal protective equipment controls for COVID-19 are also not included in the narrative.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies

He had been working at the seafood counter when he began to experience COVID-19 related symptoms and called off work.The employee last worked at the facility on November 29, 2021, and tested positive for COVID-19 on December 1, 2021.
